title: Veracruz Tourism Intelligence
subtitle: Data-driven exploration of tourism destinations in Veracruz
overview_text: Browse 55 selected destinations organized into 12 data-derived similarity groups. Each place can be explored on its own; a group is not a package or travel route.
destinations_text: Find destinations by interest. Open any card to see its reviewed characteristics and why it belongs to its experience group.
no_results: No destinations match the selected filters.
cluster_note: Experience-group names are editorial descriptions of tourism-character similarity—not verified itineraries, popularity rankings, or evidence of low crowding.
structural_note: These comparisons are structural analogues only. Similarity does not constitute demand evidence or route feasibility.
no_structural_analogues: No structural-anchor comparison is currently produced for this destination.
methods_title: How the destination groups were made
methods_text: The group labels are editorial names for similarities found by the algorithm, not official tourism regions. We do not rank the places by popularity.
why_group_heading: Why is this destination in this group?
comparison_intro: Compare the reviewed tourism characteristics with the group representative:
both_pueblos_magicos: Both places are designated Pueblos Mágicos.
pueblo_status_differs: The places differ in Pueblo Mágico status.
representative_unavailable: The group representative was not found in the current destination data.
comparison_limit: This explains the visible similarities. Actual groups were calculated from eight tourism-theme flags plus Pueblo Mágico status using Gower distance and PAM. Other group members affect the result. It does not imply a shared itinerary, similar visitor counts or available tours.
step_one_body: One row for each of 55 selected places. Features come from documented information and reviewed project classifications.
step_two_body: Eight reviewed tourism themes and Pueblo Mágico status are compared with Gower distance. PAM groups the 55 places into 12 clusters.
step_three_body: Each destination card shows its reviewed themes and an editorial name for the group. Open a card to compare it with the group representative.
separate_catalog_note: Separate dataset: 295 cards collected from an official Veracruz tourism-offerings catalog. Those are listings describing experiences or tours, not another 295 destinations. They did not define the 12 groups.
limited_demand_note: Important: similarity does not prove low crowding, booking availability or a practical travel route. We have direct visitor-demand measurements for only part of the 55-place catalog.
experience_intro: Explore twelve collections of places with similar documented tourism characteristics. Select one to see its destinations. Each place can be visited independently.
lab_intro: Choose two places to see the characteristics the algorithm compares. This learning section can be removed from the final tourist website.
compare_explanation: Zero means identical profiles under the included characteristics. This measures coded similarity, not driving distance.
pam_intro: Mini-demonstration with four real destination profiles and two representatives. The published 12 groups were calculated separately from all 55 destinations.
pam_step1_desc: Choose the destination with the smallest sum of distances to the other three.
pam_step2_desc: Try each remaining place; select the one giving the lowest total distance to the nearest representative.
pam_step3_desc: Try replacing either representative with another place. Keep a swap only if it reduces total distance.
lab_limitations: Source: project-curated tourism themes and verified Pueblo Mágico status. A recorded 0 means this theme was not coded as evidenced; it is not proof that the experience does not exist. No visitor demand, bookings or route distances are used.
groups_not_routes: These places share tourism characteristics. They do not automatically form a suggested route.
